_comment: Tiered model registry for the SystemOne model router (POST /v1/systemone/route). The router uses a cheap local GLiClass decision engine (Jev-style) to pick the CHEAPEST tier sufficient for each task. Tier descriptions are written contrastively (what each tier FAILS at) because the zero-shot classifier discriminates on capability boundaries, not marketing copy. Tiers with model_id=null are not routable until configured. latency_ms_p50: fill from measured runs (the shim logs per-decision latency to logs/systemone-shim.log) so routing claims carry receipts. TOPOLOGY (2026-09-26): The Windows PC (Batman) is the primary LM Studio inference host (127.0.0.1:1234); the Mac mini reaches it via LM Link (Mac localhost:1234 forwards to the PC). Mac-local models are backups. Only one model is loaded at a time on the PC; currently the 9B (Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B) - the 35B was unloaded at his request. His loaded model is never evicted by SystemOne. minicpm5-2b (economy) is currently Mac-local only. Each tier's models[] feeds expected-utility ranking (ranked_models): quality = seeded expected task-success rate per tier mix (config, tune over time), cost = relative cost units (latency x size proxy), available = in the LM Studio inventory (refreshed at shim startup, SYSTEMONE_INVENTORY_TTL). Rankings are advisory only — SystemOne never loads or switches models.

economy.description: Handles ONLY trivial tasks: one-sentence summaries, simple factual Q&A, basic rewrites, classification, extraction. FAILS at reasoning, code, math, navigation, tool use, browser actions, or anything multi-step or agentic.

balanced.description: Handles everyday tasks: explanations, emails, brainstorming, simple scripts, planning, general chat. FAILS at hard reasoning, complex debugging, advanced math, large codebases.

heavy.description: Handles HARD tasks: complex reasoning, code generation and debugging, multithreaded race conditions, advanced math, long-context analysis, agent planning, multi-step browser navigation and automation, MCP tool calls, high-stakes judgment. Routable when loaded.
heavy.note: Served on the Windows PC (Batman) via LM Link - the Mac's localhost:1234 forwards to the PC's :1234. Only one model is loaded at a time on the PC (currently the 9B, Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B); the 35B was unloaded at his request. SystemOne never evicts a loaded model.
